{{Top|leg}}
The '''Home Defense Strike Force''' was a smaller strike force hastily assembled by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] from those [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] of the [[Coruscant Defense Fleet/Legends|Coruscant Home Fleet]] that remained in the [[Coruscant system/Legends|Coruscant system]] at the time of the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|surprise attack]] by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] [[Confederate Navy/Legends|forces]]. The [[Home Fleet Strike Group Five/Legends|Home Fleet Strike Group Five]] was one of the smaller groups organized during the defense of the capital.
